Maximum safe operating voltage and contact derating are not established by the typ voltage row.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Missing maximum voltage and default physical binding. Resolution: Resolvable only as an explicit alternate (SJ1-3535NG), not the default Ledino KB3SPRS footprint. The archived Same Sky sheet p2 gives the per-pin table (1 sleeve, 2 tip, 3 ring, 4 tip switch, 5 ring switch) and the PCB layout numbers 1#..5#; p1 gives rated input current 1 A (max column), contact resistance 50 mOhm max, rated input voltage 12 Vdc. The voltage is printed in the typ column: there is no separate maximum anywhere in the source. Closing the 'maximum voltage' blocker therefore requires accepting the manufacturer's rated input voltage as the working-voltage ceiling (checks must never exceed 12 Vdc); it must not be relabelled an absolute maximum. Reviewer decision required on that point.
